firstPlayerRule: There is no fixed first player. Each round, characters and monsters act in initiative order, and whoever revealed the lowest initiative value goes first.
officialTieBreak: If characters tie, compare the initiative values of their second played cards; if still tied, the party decides. A character acts before a monster set with the same initiative. In all other ties, the party decides.
clarifications: At the start of each round, each character secretly picks two ability cards and marks one as the initiative card; the initiative value on that card sets their position.
A character who declares a long rest acts on initiative 99.
Initiative order is recalculated every round, so the first actor can change each round.
